decision_tree.condition: shuffled-label negative control succeeds too well
decision_tree.next_action: Stop; audit labels, folds, sampler and metrics.

decision_tree.condition: SupCon loss decreases but validation macro-F1 does not improve
decision_tree.interpretation: Embedding alignment alone may not solve task signal, labels, or classifier calibration.
decision_tree.next_action: Inspect embedding distance metrics and per-subject risk before adding VREx or changing labels.

decision_tree.condition: VREx reduces risk variance but macro-F1 does not improve
decision_tree.interpretation: Subject risk stability improved without enough class signal.
decision_tree.next_action: Consider CE/SupCon balance, task formulation, or representation—not claim success.

decision_tree.condition: Only EMG or only EEG improves
decision_tree.interpretation: Subject variability may be modality-dependent or representation-dependent.
decision_tree.next_action: Keep modality-specific conclusions; do not fuse.
